en: Fixed SDK and `--output-format stream-json` output dropping a subagent's remaining messages and final report after it is moved to the background mid-run (e.g. by `CLAUDE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_TASKS`)
zh: 修复了 SDK 和 `--output-format stream-json` 输出在 subagent 运行中途被移到后台（例如由 `CLAUDE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_TASKS` 触发）后，丢失该 subagent 剩余消息和最终报告的问题
